alert: Sonarr cannot import completed downloads (dead debrid links)
description: Sonarr keeps failing to read files it is trying to import. With debrid symlinks this means the target is dead: the mount lists the file but reads return I/O errors (an expired torrent RD refuses to re-insert).

filter.expression: service.name = 'sonarr' AND severity_text = 'ERROR' AND logger IN ('ImportDecisionMaker', 'VideoFileInfoReader')

annotations.summary: Sonarr import errors: unreadable files behind the symlinks
annotations.description: Find the release in the arr's queue, then delete + re-add that torrent in decypharr (repair can't fix a can't-retry re-insert). Cross-check decypharr logs for 'Failed to stream'.
